fact: readTaskbook treats the entire argument as one path. It strips surrounding whitespace and paired outer double quotes while preserving spaces within the path.

enterTaskbook decodes prepared arguments with readEntryArgument and resolves the working directory through the T3 binding when present. It reads prepared files with readTaskbook and user input with readTaskbookInput.
readTaskbookInput parses pasted Markdown and saves a copy keyed by taskbook digest under the shared Git directory. The T3 continuation can read that copy from its linked worktree.
After entry validation, enterTaskbook opens the run record. For a runnable task, startPhase dispatches work for its recorded phase.
